name: Men's USAF-style mess dress: general officer sleeve braid overlay (1 1/2 in, 3 in from the sleeve end)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-male. Braid 1.5 in wide per CAPR 39-1 4.1.1.1 (the sleeve end is 3 in below its lower edge). Mess dress braid tone: lighter blue taken from the dress's own satin shawl collar (line #2c4a96, band #18306e, edge #0a1740 against the coat #001c52, about 3.6x the coat luminance), not the tonal Class A look, because the tonal braid could not be seen on the mess dress (Doran D37). Drawn as 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)
